descriptive_findings: The nine source-context panels show the selected four-row cells as compact four-row episodes; none shows an unambiguous warm narrow ridge continuing through all 16 rows.
In every one of the five other-scan panels for the strongest source track, the local exact maximum moves to a different four-row window and native path instead of repeating the fixed source path.
The other-scan local maxima visually follow isolated warm-cell combinations in otherwise mixed residual fields; they are post-data local maxima, not fixed-path confirmations.
No panel supplies an independent visit, calibrated morphology likelihood, physical origin or qualified OFF veto.
method: Manual visual review of the fourteen saved, hash-bound residual-waterfall PNGs and their saved marker metadata. No pixels were rescored and no threshold was introduced.
